_how_to_use: Copy next to the artifact, rename to scene-spec.json, replace every <...> placeholder and delete this key. Keys mirror evidence/artifacts/legacy-early-slice/scene-spec.json. Keep claims_to_visuals honest: one row per thing a viewer could read as fact.
objective: <one sentence: what the viewer should understand, explore or feel>
custom_choices: <a decision the catalog did not make for you, and why>

runtime.render_scheduling: Demand-driven RAF, max 60 fps, hidden-tab suspension, camera/input invalidation; <n>px shadow map.

scenes.motion: <decorative | discrete state transition | fixed-step simulation | data playback>
boundaries: <what this scene does not claim: no ecology, no measured discharge, illustrative scale>

physical_contract.time: <fixed step and delta cap, or 'authored keyframes only'>

claims_to_visuals.source: <record id or URL, read on YYYY-MM-DD>
claims_to_visuals.visual: <the geometry, label, colour or motion that carries it>
claims_to_visuals.verified_by: <capture file, computed check, or 'author read only'>

selection_scope: <which parts of the artifact these records actually guided>
